CustomField.description: Map region of this brick as a GeoJSON Polygon or MultiPolygon, coordinates in [longitude, latitude] order. Drawn and edited in the Bricks Manager on the Admin Console. Distributor sales are placed in the brick whose region contains the pharmacy location.
